'''Shaun McCarthy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 North Dartmouth tournament]] on 13 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down with Dueling]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d754">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-17-north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000d754/ north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 17 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-17-north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000d754/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
